title: Higher pulled-back counit maps
statement: Let $k,k'$ be algebraically closed fields, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and let $a:X'\to X$ be the top arrow of a cartesian field-extension square [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ a dense open, and $\epsilon:j_!j^*F\to F$ its canonical counit [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. For each $q>1$, the map $H^q(a^*\epsilon)$ on the underlying abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is bijective. No torsion, reducedness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), proof: the five-term exact sequence and remark (c)

proof.text: Apply dense_open_baseChange_boundary to V=a inverse image U. Its complement is finite, consists of closed points and has separably closed residue fields. The boundary theorem proves this independently of the sheaf and its coefficients.

Let εΛ be the actual module counit and ε its image under forgetting coefficients. The proved instance isIso_upperStar_map_openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction_counit from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.OpenClosed.Complex makes j inverse image εΛ an isomorphism, by the adjunction triangle identity and the invertibility of the unit for the fully faithful extension by zero. Use exists_upperStar_forget₂_natIso and NatIso.isIso_map_iff to transport this to an isomorphism j inverse image ε on underlying abelian sheaves.

The restricted scheme morphism satisfies (a restricted to U) composed with j = V.ι composed with a. Compose the inverse of upperStarComp for V.ι,a with upperStarComp for a restricted to U,j. NatIso.isIso_map_iff identifies V inverse image a inverse image ε with the further inverse image of j inverse image ε, which is an isomorphism because functors preserve isomorphisms. This transports the actual counit morphism, without choosing an extension-by-zero replacement.

For q>1 write q=n+2. Apply the already proved finite-support theorem bijective_H_map_of_isIso_upperStar_map on X', with open V and morphism a inverse image ε. The preceding boundary and restriction assertions give all its hypotheses.

theorem dense_open_pulled_counit_high (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k']
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    {ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of k')}
    {ι' : X' ⟶ X} (h : IsPullback ι' f' f ι)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let ε := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).counit.app F)
    ∀ q : ℕ, 1 < q → Function.Bijective
      (Sheaf.H.map (((ι')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map ε) q)
